evidenceBoundary: Local Windows x64 and Ubuntu 24.04 x64 under WSL2; exact frozen source and separate package batches. Dynamic CLR Host requires JIT; Native AOT evidence applies to static clients/probes. Node is used by independent TS/reference gates, not the Settings .NET chain. This is not complete Typert, hosted CI, remote SourceLink retrieval, Maker execution, named UI framework validation, publication or dependency-selection acceptance.

Full Settings operations and base/user layers

retentionRepair.action: Copy-only recovery by rereading the actual still-accessible source/cache; every byte matches the first capture SHA. Preserve original capture and collision directory. No gate rerun or reconstruction.

watchRepair.confirmedMechanism: An existing config parent was watched recursively, admitting SDK subdirectory traffic before managed filtering. Native overflow loses individual notifications; reporting without a refresh could leave configuration stale until a later matching event.
watchRepair.repair: Use depth-zero observation for an existing canonical parent; retain recursive observation for missing ancestors. Report the original overflow and request one coalesced refresh through the existing queue. Closed watches reject late error callbacks.
watchRepair.platformAdaptation: FileSystemWatcher cannot express finite positive depth. Missing-ancestor observation remains broader than pinned DSH. Pinned DSH only warns on runtime watcher errors; overflow resynchronization is an explicit native recovery adaptation.
watchRepair.historicalCauseBoundary: Private instrumented copies, unchanged original 10-second assertions. Diagnostic passes are separate from frozen full-gate acceptance. Earlier failures had no trace; their unique causes were not reproduced or retroactively proven.
watchRepair.historicalRecordCorrection: The first uninstrumented HMR failure timed out on the third Change (invalid disabled expression), not the second result. Preserve the original receipt and raw logs; this record supplies the correction.

independentEvidenceReview.scope: Frozen source Git blobs, all three package batches and symbols, native TRX, verify and authoring steps, no-Git stages, five consumer captures and exact restored package sources, diagnostic traces and historical failure records.
independentEvidenceReview.linuxTimingBoundary: The original Linux inputs were copied at collection time. Copy-only case recovery reread original source and cache while accessible; every byte matched the first capture. At later independent review, the original Linux temporary directory was unavailable. That review checked first capture hashes, retained exact-case archive bytes, saved restore metadata and preserved failed-collection records; it does not claim a later original-directory reread.
